name: week/traffic
sql:
(SELECT 'week' AS bucket, to_jsonb(q) AS result
    FROM (VALUES (1)) anchor(n) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
SELECT date_trunc('hour',timestamp) AS bucket,event_type,count(*),count(DISTINCT event->>'clientId') clients
FROM raw
WHERE environment='lesswrong.com'
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01'
  AND timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08'
  AND event_type IN ('pageLoadFinished','navigate')
GROUP BY 1,2

) q ON true)
ORDER BY bucket;
